augments.name: Fortified
augments.description: Gain 20 Armor, then increase your bonus Armor by 25%.

augments.name: Mystic Guard
augments.description: Gain 20 Magic Resist, then increase your bonus Magic Resist by 25%.

augments.name: Slime Time
augments.description: Every few seconds, Autocast a burst of slime from your body, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If you hit a champion, secrete a blob that heals you when walked over.

augments.name: Steadfaster Presence
augments.description: Gain bonus Armor, Magic Resist, and Tenacity. This bonus increases below 40% maximum Health.

augments.name: Tooth Fairy
augments.description: Bursting enemies drops Teeth. Picking up Teeth grants permanent Lethality and Magic Penetration.
